review_comment: Authentication settings initialized to false by default, which could enable unauthorized access in production environments without explicit configuration changes
Authorization settings initialized to false by default, which could enable unauthorized access in production environments without explicit configuration changes
The secret used for session management is generated using a non-cryptographically secure random string function, which could be predictable and vulnerable to session hijacking attacks
Password comparison uses direct equality check which is vulnerable to timing attacks, allowing attackers to potentially determine correct passwords through timing analysis
The authentication logic uses insecure basic auth implementation with direct password equality check rather than constant-time comparison
Session management authorization uses a custom implementation which lacks proper validation and could be vulnerable to unauthorized access
